## PlatformerController

`class` from [`src/addons/platformer/PlatformerController.js`](../../../src/addons/platformer/PlatformerController.js)

Attach to a GameObject with position and positive size. OnUpdate captures input; OnFixedUpdate owns movement. The supplied world.Move(body, dt) mutates position and velocity and returns grounded/contact flags. No loop or canvas is created. Set input:null and call SetInput for AI, replay or a custom input implementation.

## TilePlatformerWorld

`class` from [`src/addons/platformer/TilePlatformerWorld.js`](../../../src/addons/platformer/TilePlatformerWorld.js)

TileCollision2D adapter for solid rectangular tiles. Positions and velocities use pixels and seconds. Substeps prevent fast actors skipping a whole tile. Slopes, one-way platforms and moving platforms are outside this adapter.
